messages.subject: Pinnacle House - section 38A contracting out
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

Landlord's notice under section 38A LTA 1954 served today (19 August). As completion is more than 14 days away, Brookmere can make a simple declaration. Please arrange for the declaration to be made and returned. The lease will be excluded from sections 24-28.

Elena
